correctness.rationale: Derived weighted harmonic monomial action on the angular orthonormal basis using moments mu_k=Gamma(beta+1)Gamma(k+1)/Gamma(k+beta+1), beta=alpha+1. The commutator vanishes outside -k with 1<=k<m+n and sends these to distinct analytic modes, so absolute three-branch coefficients are the complete singular list. Interior gamma-ratio asymptotics at k/n→t yield the three continuous expressions f_beta,lambda(t); uniform coefficient bound 2 controls vanishing-proportion neighborhoods of 0,1,lambda,lambda+1. Riemann sums prove weak empirical law and every p>0 positive moment, while strong nullity of each T_d follows on basis and uniform contractivity. At beta=1 the branch monotonicity locates the exact maximum at k=n or m, giving n(m-n)/((m+1)^(3/2)sqrt(n+1)); optimizing ratio and letting m=3n gives sup 2/(3sqrt3). Recomputed direct two-step operator coefficients over 9741 cases, max error <4e-16; finite checks supplement analytic asymptotics.
residual_risks: Any independent finite diagnostic is corroborative only; universal statements rest on inspected proof.
